horizon: near t400, original authenticated evolving adult genotypes, one reproductive ledger
estimand: Static within-E original-genome intervention: source E versus same E genome with investment alleles replaced by matched fixed-arm mean; inherited assurance and visitor assemblage held constant. Not longitudinal mediation.
partition: Symmetric exact two-factor Shapley between maternal ovule budget O and recipient pollen receipt r; sum equals source difference to <3e-11.
major_result: Mean delivered pollen drops in all four original settings but mean maternal viable seed output increases in prior/pollen_discount/assurance_cost, because resource savings and recipient-specific pollen effects offset. Prior's Shapley pollen-receipt component mean is positive although total delivery declines; total delivery does not identify recipient-specific fecundity.
history_level_caveat: History signs are mixed; all within one previously exposed 64-history model cohort, first of 8 nested demographic repeats only.
causal_limit: The interventions fix evolving genotype matching and assurance while imposing a branch mean on investment; Shapley components are a decomposition of a selected STATIC source counterfactual, not causal mediation of 1000-step assurance evolution. Group viable seeds != unconditional fitness/occupancy; cannot claim evolutionary suicide or genetic underinvestment.
